title: Bio-Physarum + NSGA-II simulation record (method validation)
scope_note: This run is method-validation evidence only. Its network lies ~2-3 km west of the provisional site boundary (~140 m overlap), so it is NOT entered as formal geometry and no coordinate translation/fabrication is performed. The public site package provides no official heritage geometry. The author's own manually-digitized heritage boundary (data/heritage/heritage_boundary.geojson, MODEL credibility / trust B, penalties class_I=1.5 & class_IV=3.0, protection_scope=hard block) is loaded by the evaluator; in the H2-seg3 Pareto results the optimized skeleton (top-10% conductivity) edges do not fall inside the class_I/class_IV penalty zones, so f3≡f2 numerically. The recorded '0 heritage crossings' is therefore the g1 hard-constraint (protection_scope) crossing count only, NOT an independent in-site heritage-protection compliance conclusion.

reproducibility.doc: proposal.md#可复现性说明（方法验证）
reproducibility.bit_exact_note: NSGA-II runs multi-process (n_proc=8); evaluation order and float reduction vary by OS/hardware, so bit-exact reproduction is not guaranteed and objective values are approximate.
reproducibility.heritage_geometry_note: data/heritage/heritage_boundary.geojson is manually digitized (MODEL credibility, trust B, geometry_origin=manual_digitization), NOT official redline geometry; its legal basis is the official four-side text (京政发〔1984〕128号 / 文物局 2018-01-02 公告), while the statutory map and redline drawing are marked 未获取 (not obtained).

algorithm.physarum_reference: Tero A. et al. (2010) Rules for biologically inspired adaptive network design, Science 327(5964): 439-442. DOI 10.1126/science.1177894
algorithm.nsga2_reference: Deb K. et al. (2002) A fast and elitist multiobjective genetic algorithm: NSGA-II, IEEE TEVC 6(2): 182-197. DOI 10.1109/4235.996017

problem.minimization_convention: pymoo unified minimization: f1 efficiency (max -> negated), f2 cost (min), f3 heritage (min), f4 service coverage (max -> negated)

f3.name: heritage_impact
f3.note: sum of length x heritage_factor; the manually-digitized heritage boundary (MODEL credibility) assigns class_I=1.5 / class_IV=3.0, but the optimized skeleton edges do not fall inside these penalty zones, so f3 ≡ f2 in the recorded results

C.label: 服务覆盖优先
C.rule: f4 service coverage maximum (f3≡f2 coincides with B, re-judged by rule)

D.label: 综合均衡
D.rule: minimum euclidean distance to utopia point

energy_estimate_note: energy_used_kwh is an estimate: total seg3 wall 5035.65 s x 8 CPU processes at ~15 W/core, divided evenly across the 6 non-dominated solutions; energy_budget_kwh is a conservative per-task ceiling. Figures are the author's own run estimates, not audited metering.

physarum_heritage_crossing_count.note: g1 hard-constraint behavior only. Run7 also records class_I_control = 0 and class_IV_control = 4, and f3≡f2 because no official heritage geometry is supplied; this value is NOT an independent in-site heritage-protection compliance conclusion.

physarum_recommended_plan_uds.source: phase5 round2 expert review mean score for plan_03 (城市融合), round2_summary.md
physarum_recommended_plan_uds.note: plan_03 genotype = D (综合均衡) fused with C (覆盖优先); skeleton_n_edges = 167, skeleton_total_length_m = 8813.1.
